scenarios.name: Header and Navigation Display
scenarios.description: Verify that the header section displays the MirDB product name, logo, and tagline prominently, with functional navigation links

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB landing page in a browser
steps.context: Page should be accessible at the root URL

steps.description: Check that the header contains MirDB logo/name, and navigation links for Features, Getting Started, Documentation, and GitHub
steps.context: REQ-1: Display MirDB product name, logo, and tagline prominently

steps.description: Click each navigation link and verify it scrolls to or navigates to the correct section
steps.context: All navigation links should be functional and lead to appropriate destinations

test_cases.input: Load landing page and inspect header element
test_cases.expected: Header contains MirDB logo/name text visible and prominently displayed

test_cases.input: Check for navigation links in header
test_cases.expected: Navigation contains links: Features, Getting Started, Documentation, GitHub
Page scrolls to or displays the Features section
Link opens GitHub repository in new tab or navigates to GitHub

scenarios.name: Hero Section Value Proposition
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section presents a clear value proposition explaining Memcached-compatible persistent storage with appropriate CTAs

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB landing page
steps.context: Hero section should be immediately visible above the fold

steps.description: Check for compelling headline, value proposition text (2-3 sentences), and CTAs
steps.context: REQ-2: Present a hero section with clear value proposition

steps.description: Verify 'Get Started' and 'View on GitHub' buttons are present and functional
steps.context: CTAs should be visually prominent and clickable

test_cases.input: Inspect hero section for headline text
test_cases.expected: Headline mentions persistent storage and/or Memcached compatibility
Value proposition explains the combination of Memcached protocol with persistent storage in 2-3 sentences
'Get Started' button is visible and clickable
'View on GitHub' link is visible and links to GitHub repository
User is navigated to Getting Started section or documentation

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the features section showcases key capabilities including LSM tree architecture, Memcached protocol support, and persistence

steps.description: Scroll to or click navigation to Features section
steps.context: REQ-3: Showcase key features

steps.description: Check that features are displayed in a card or grid layout
steps.context: Layout should be visually organized and scannable

steps.description: Confirm all key features are present: Memcached Protocol, Persistent Storage, LSM Tree, Async Performance, Configurable Storage
steps.context: All differentiating features should be highlighted

test_cases.input: Check Features section for Memcached Protocol feature
test_cases.expected: Feature card/item for 'Memcached Protocol Compatibility' is displayed with description

test_cases.input: Check Features section for Persistent Storage feature
test_cases.expected: Feature card/item for 'Persistent Storage with SSTables' is displayed with description

test_cases.input: Check Features section for LSM Tree feature
test_cases.expected: Feature card/item for 'LSM Tree Architecture' is displayed with description

test_cases.input: Check Features section for Async Performance feature
test_cases.expected: Feature card/item for 'Async Performance with Tokio' is displayed with description
Features are displayed in a grid or card layout, not plain list

scenarios.name: Getting Started Section
scenarios.description: Verify the Getting Started section provides installation commands, configuration examples, and basic usage instructions

steps.description: Scroll to or click navigation to Getting Started section
steps.context: REQ-4: Provide Getting Started section with basic usage instructions

steps.description: Check for cargo build command and server run command
steps.context: Commands should be in code blocks with syntax highlighting

steps.description: Check for TOML configuration example showing key parameters
steps.context: REQ-6: Include configuration overview

steps.description: Check for basic memcached client usage example
steps.context: REQ-10: Include code examples demonstrating basic operations

test_cases.input: Check for cargo build command in Getting Started
test_cases.expected: Code block contains 'cargo build --release' or similar build command
Code block contains command to run mirdb-server with configuration file
Configuration example shows addr, work_dir, mem_table_max_size, sst_max_size parameters
Example shows connecting with telnet or memcached client and basic SET/GET operations

test_cases.input: Verify code blocks have syntax highlighting
test_cases.expected: Code blocks use monospace font and have appropriate syntax highlighting for bash/TOML

scenarios.name: Supported Commands Section
scenarios.description: Verify the supported Memcached commands are displayed with explanations

steps.description: Scroll to or locate the commands reference section
steps.context: REQ-5: Display supported Memcached commands

steps.description: Check that all supported commands are listed: SET, GET, DELETE, ADD, REPLACE, APPEND, PREPEND, INFO
steps.context: Commands should have brief explanations

test_cases.input: Check for SET command in commands list

test_cases.input: Check for GET command in commands list
test_cases.expected: GET command is listed with description about retrieving keys

test_cases.input: Check for DELETE command in commands list
test_cases.expected: DELETE command is listed with description about removing keys
Commands section lists SET, GET, DELETE, ADD, REPLACE, APPEND, PREPEND, INFO

test_cases.input: Verify commands are in table or structured list format
test_cases.expected: Commands are displayed in a table with Command and Description columns, or similarly structured format

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Desktop
scenarios.description: Verify the page displays correctly on desktop viewport sizes

steps.context: NFR-1: Page must be fully responsive

steps.description: Check that all sections display properly with appropriate spacing and alignment
steps.context: Content should be readable and well-organized

steps.description: Verify navigation is fully visible and functional on desktop
steps.context: No hamburger menu needed on desktop

test_cases.expected: Page renders correctly with no horizontal scroll, all content visible
Full navigation links visible in header (not collapsed into hamburger menu)
Features display in multi-column grid layout
Code blocks display full width with readable font size, no overflow

scenarios.name: Page Performance
scenarios.description: Verify the page loads within acceptable performance thresholds

steps.description: Load the page and measure time to interactive
steps.context: NFR-2: Initial page load must complete within 3 seconds

steps.description: Execute Lighthouse performance audit on the page
steps.context: Success Criteria: Lighthouse performance score of 90+

steps.description: Verify images are optimized, minimal external dependencies
steps.context: Page should minimize external fonts and scripts

test_cases.input: Load page and measure load time
test_cases.expected: Page loads completely within 3 seconds on standard connection
Lighthouse performance score is 90 or higher
Images below the fold use lazy loading (loading='lazy' attribute)
Page loads with minimal external font/script requests
Images are appropriately compressed and sized

scenarios.name: Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Verify the page meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards

steps.description: Execute Lighthouse accessibility audit on the page
steps.context: NFR-3: Page must meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards

steps.description: Navigate entire page using only keyboard (Tab, Enter, Space)
steps.context: All interactive elements should be keyboard accessible

steps.description: Check that text has sufficient contrast against backgrounds
steps.context: WCAG 2.1 AA requires 4.5:1 contrast for normal text

steps.description: Verify all images have appropriate alt text
steps.context: NFR-7: All images must have appropriate alt text

test_cases.expected: Lighthouse accessibility score is 90 or higher
All links, buttons, and form elements are focusable via keyboard
Visible focus indicator appears on all focused elements

test_cases.input: Verify color contrast of body text
test_cases.expected: Body text has at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background

test_cases.input: Check all images for alt attributes
test_cases.expected: All img elements have meaningful alt text or alt='' for decorative images
Headings follow logical order (h1, h2, h3) without skipping levels
Page content is announced correctly by screen reader
